start2.title: Field
start2.text:
Scobby: [Wake up, you lazy shit, it's time to spar. You're gonna die out there if you don't learn how to fight properly.]

You get up from your sleeping bag and look around.
You see Cheese writing on his journal on a tree nearby, and Scobby poking you with a sparring stick.

opt.text: Time for some sparring, I guess
I already know about fighting properly

sparring.title: Field
sparring.text:
Scobby: [Let's learn about the basics of combat.]

Scobby: [You have a set of moves which can be viewed from your profile screen that you can access through the button on the top right. These are the moves that you are able to perform in combat.]

Scobby: [Combat goes back and forth. Unless ambushed, you will usually have the first turn. Currently your speed is 2, which means you will get to perform 2 actions before passing turn to the enemy.]

Scobby: [Since you are not very skilled in fighting yet, you will have trouble dealing damage. Let me teach you an offensive move.

You learn <Tackle>!

Use your new skill to try to deal damage to me. Let's spar!]

sparring2.title: Field
sparring2.text:
Scobby: [No offense, but you are almost as weak as Cheese... anyways, let's go over the moves you used.]

Scobby: [As you experienced, you have 3 random skills chosen from your knowledge pool each turn. When you use up all of the skills from the pool, you had the option to 'Gather yourself' and re-stock all of the skills. Also, you may have noticed that only the skill that is currently usable is shown to you. For example, you don't have the option to grab me when I'm disengaged.]

Scobby: [Let me go in depth about the skill 'Disengage'. When you disengage, you are staying outside the enemy's attack range, and they will have to spend a turn to engage before attacking you.]

Scobby: [However, when you are disengaged, you may still be attacked by ranged attacks. This goes for you, too: If you want to use a bow or any ranged attacks, you are going to have to be disengaged first.]

Scobby: [Now, let me teach you some discipline. It's not good to panic in combat.]

sparring3.title: Field
sparring3.text:
You forget skill <Panic>!

Hours pass. It is now %time.

Scobby: [Phew, now you're a little more of a hunter. Would you like a round of sparring before we end this session?]

sparring skip.title: Field
sparring skip.text:
Scobby: [...Are you sure? Fine. Let me at least teach you a combat skill.
Wind up buffs up your next attack to deal double damage.
Cripple deals 1 damage and make them unable to move for 3 turns.
Charge allows you to engage and deal 1 damage when disengaged.]

sparring end.title: River side
sparring end.text:
You, Cheese, and Scobby travel North through the forests for a day until you see a body of water blocking the way.

Scobby: [This is the river that separates our land from foreign lands. All the scouts that had gone to the other side of this river in the past 5 years never made it back...]

You should set up a camp here so you can start building a raft to cross the river.

river camp.title: River side
river camp.text:
You are at camp. Scobby is busy building a raft.

Scobby: [Please get me some sturdy woods while you are out scouting.]

River camp help.title: River side
River camp help.text: Scobby: [It doesn't look like the wildlife here are any more dangerous than the ones near Ant Hill. If you can bring me a chitin piece, I may be able to finish building this a lot quicker.]

opt.text: Ask Scobby to join the hunt

River camp help2.title: River side
River camp help2.text:
Scobby: [You're right. It's better to move together. Let's go!]

Scobby joins you.

river scout.title: River side
river scout.text:
Just as you leave camp to scout, Cheese comes running towards you.

Cheese: [Can I come with? I want some adventure too!]

river scout1-1.title: River side
river scout1-1.text:
Cheese joins you.

You start scouting around the camp.

Cheese: [I heard you tried to fight a wolf spider. How did that go?]

You tell him about your story.

Cheese: [Wow, you are pretty weak!]

You hear a sound.

river scout1-2.title: River side
river scout1-2.text:
Cheese joins you.

You and Cheese scout around for a while.
You don't see anything out of the ordinary.

Cheese: [I hope we run into something dangerous. I always wanted to be a hunter, but my father is a lame-ass priest.]

You hear something.

river scout2-1.title: River side
river scout2-1.text: You scout the woods along the river. This area is humid and abundant with fruits, which means there are dangerous predators nearby... Actually, you hear one coming your way right now. Hopefully the sparring practice helps.

river scout3.title: River side
river scout3.text:
You are still out in the woods.
It is %time.

river scout4.title: River side
river scout4.text: You are walking around in the woods again. You hear something.

river quest.title: River
river quest.text:
You provide the sturdy wood.
It is %time.

Scobby: [The raft is done... Let's get rowing.]%temp

---

You row your way across the river.

Scobby: [So, according to the map, this river will take about 2 hours to cross. Cheese, please stop touching the water. We don't want to attract fish.]

Scobby: [Let's take this time to talk about our mission. Do you have any questions for me?]

ask mission.title: River
ask mission.text:
Scobby: [5 years ago, Ant Hill used to trade food and crafts with the neighboring settlements. Then the roads started becoming very dangerous.
Wolf spiders abducting people in broad daylight is like a monthly event now...

Every year, the priest and the leaders of Ant Hill gather and choose 2 people to leave and find contact with the outside, so we may import things like crossbows and destructive spells to defend ourselves...]

ask hunting.title: River
ask hunting.text:
Scobby: [As you know, the main source of food in Ant Hill is meat from hunted bugs. Ant Hill has always been thriving ever since we had conquered the hill from fire ants, although recently our population has been stagnant due to people constantly being ambushed and kidnapped. That's all thanks to us hunters who provide plenty of meat to the market in Ant Hill.

Most of the men in Ant Hill are hunters like me, and you should sooner or later learn how to hunt.
Maybe if we get to hunt a beetle, I will make you a real weapon. Good weapons give you many offensive skills and are essential for hunting.]

other side.title: River side
other side.text:
The three of you arrive on the other side of the river.
Nothing looks too different. Trees, green landscape, nothing out of the ordinary.
What could be out here that completely destroyed the connection with the outside world for the past 5 years? What is going on out there?

Scobby: [The last scout sent out before us was a hunter named Arly. She was a pretty good hunter, very skilled at hunting with axes. She was once a scout like you, but she learned how to fight and had become a hunter.]

Scobby gives you one of those looks.
